description: Chapter and scene joins in a documentary or podcast mix: J-cuts (ambience pre-laps), L-cuts (music and live tails), music-to-music seams, live-sound edges, act-boundary breaths, key-line ladders, designed and memory-POV silences, and the ending ladder, applied mechanically to a cue sheet with opendubstage transitions and verified with check_transitions / bridge_gaps. Use when scenes "stop dead", when a cut into live sound is abrupt, when two songs meet, when someone asks for a J-cut, L-cut, sound bridge or crossfade length, when designing how a film ends, or when a boundary has no sound spanning it. Do NOT use for narration cuts inside a passage (dialogue-editing-and-restoration) or for duck envelopes (music-under-narration).
